description: Phase 6: Final build verification, fix all compile errors, commit everything, ensure all scripts pass sh -n
steps: Run full daemon build: GOROOT=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8 PATH=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin:$PATH GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -X main.version=3.0.0' -o /tmp/sshcustomd ./cmd/sshcustomd/ (from daemon/ directory). Fix ALL errors until it passes.

Run go vet: GOROOT=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8 PATH=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin:$PATH GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./... (from daemon/ directory). Fix ALL warnings.

Run sh -n on all module scripts: sh -n module/scripts/ssh.iptables && sh -n module/scripts/ovpn.service && sh -n module/scripts/ssh.service && sh -n module/scripts/ssh.tool && sh -n module/scripts/vpnchain.iptables && sh -n module/service.sh && sh -n module/customize.sh && sh -n module/action.sh && sh -n module/uninstall.sh. Fix any syntax errors.
Verify file command on the binary shows aarch64: file /tmp/sshcustomd
Ensure daemon/internal/webui/index.html matches module/webroot/index.html (copy if different)

git add -A && git commit with message 'feat: SSHCustom-VPNChain v3.0.0 - WebUI-only rebuild' (include details about SSH connection pool, standby mode, CORS API, profiles CRUD, Material 3 WebUI, app removal)
acceptance_criteria: go build succeeds with zero errors for GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64
go vet passes with zero issues
All changes committed on v3.0.0-webui branch
verification: GOROOT=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8 PATH=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.23.8/bin:$PATH GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -X main.version=3.0.0' -o /tmp/sshcustomd ./cmd/sshcustomd/
findings: Build passes cleanly for GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 with zero errors. Go vet passes with zero warnings. All 9 shell scripts pass sh -n syntax check. Binary confirmed as ELF 64-bit ARM aarch64. module/webroot/index.html and daemon/internal/webui/index.html are identical (same md5). The /tmp path is not writable in this sandbox so the binary was verified locally in daemon/ dir instead.
